entries.en: Are you in position?
entries.ro: Ești pe poziție?

entries.en: Just keep your head on straight, make sure to get in the right car.
entries.ro: Fii cu capul pe umeri și intră în mașina potrivită.

entries.en: Smooth sailin' so far.

entries.en: Now we wait…

entries.en: Our VIPs are back. They're about to get in.

entries.en: And... done.

entries.en: Ugh... 'K, maybe I overpromised.

entries.en: Hm. Not bad.

entries.en: Just forget it…

entries.en: V, report! What's going on?

entries.en: They're playin' defense... And they're good.
entries.ro: Joacă în apărare... Și sunt buni.

entries.en: Nothin' we didn't anticipate. Stick to the plan.

entries.en: Cams are on, transceiver is green... She's free for the takin'.

Il ne m'en fallait pas plus pour cerner le personnage." t="Saw him talk to the chief of police, pat him on the cheek like a puppy. No complaint. This told me all I needed to know." b="" a=""/>

Atât mi-a trebuit să-l înțeleg." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="fra" o="Mmm, ouais... dur... Juste comme je les aime. S'ils ont l'endurance qui va avec." t="Mmm, yes... hard... How I like them. If they have the stamina to match." b="" a=""/>
